verdict.rationale: API parity with the UI is a fair question for a corporate card and rewards product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no public API: all OpenAPI/Swagger probe paths returned 404, and the docs describe only app and web flows (card requests, withdrawals). The llms.txt file is a content listing, not a programmatic API, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
